method.source_authority: Versioned research analysis CSVs; derived annotations, not recovered original traces.
method.grain: One attempt per task_id and variant within batch; cross-batch smoke stays separate.
method.denominators: 48 panel attempts = 24 paired tasks; 18 exploration attempts = 6 tasks x 3 variants; extra 3 smoke attempts excluded from exploration.
method.statistics: Arithmetic mean and median. Quantiles use linear interpolation at (n-1)*p. Missing remains null and is never zero-filled. All numeric pair deltas are candidate minus baseline.
method.time_note: Agent duration is context_metrics for exploration/panel; smoke uses trace_max_elapsed according to CSV notes. task_duration is not GPU wall clock and does not include shared startup. First edit is trace-derived proxy; final patch production change is another variable. Neither establishes correct localization.
method.cutoff_note: 295s/300s durations, 240/270/280s edits and 50 tools are descriptive flags, not a causal classification. Timing beyond nominal limits is retained.
method.repeat_note: repeated_no_progress_actions is an existing heuristic annotation; explore notes define adj_plus_run_read_run_any. Counts do not prove true no-progress or establish repeat reduction causally.
method.paired_note: All paired comparisons retain original tasks including invalid-verification results. No post-hoc task deletion to improve scores. Repo/smoke/order cuts are descriptive.
method.causal_note: Changes are prompt interventions but one attempt per variant, stochastic sampling, shared server/order/caches, task selection and annotation uncertainty preclude strong causal or generalization claims.

all.exact_p_caveat: Descriptive conditional paired test only; no multiplicity correction, no power/equivalence claim. Task independence is not guaranteed across snapshot groups; small n.
